items.text: Seattle (Wed practice report, Nov 11; Thu report not yet posted): OUT - QB Sam Darnold (ribs, quad; Macdonald said he will not play). DNP - LT Charles Cross (ankle), LG Quenton Nelson (knee, week-to-week after procedure; both widely expected to sit until after Wk11 bye), DE Leonard Williams (stinger), DT Brandon Pili (back), DT Jarran Reed (personal), WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba (rest). Limited - QB Drew Lock (right elbow, oblique), G Anthony Bradford (knee), EDGE Derick Hall (back), EDGE Uchenna Nwosu (ankle), LB Patrick O'Connell (toe), EDGE Connor O'Toole (foot). Full - WR Rashid Shaheed (knee), TE AJ Barner (finger). Drew Lock expected to start for second straight week.
items.source: Seahawks.com (Week 10 Injury Report: Seahawks at Raiders, Nov 11)

items.text: Las Vegas (Wed practice report, Nov 11; Thu report not yet posted): one of the healthiest teams in the league - Limited - DT Thomas Booker (ankle), DT Foley Fatukasi (shoulder/back), RG Trey Zuhn III (concussion; Kubiak: starter 'if he can go', Bryce Cabeldue the fallback). Full - TE Ian Thomas (ankle). Rookie Fernando Mendoza (No. 1 overall pick) makes his first NFL start after Kirk Cousins was traded to MIN.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Raiders Get Fantastic News on Injured Starter, Nov 12)
